name: Bramble
identity: older grassland ranger; left-handed archer: bow in the RIGHT hand, quiver over the LEFT shoulder, billhook at the RIGHT hip, folding buckler on the RIGHT forearm
home_region_note: Claude K's proposal on #149 (25 Oct), not yet decided by Matt; it only sets the tier material

abilities.kit: game/data/abilities/bramble.json (Codex, #261); base and powered form unchanged

techniques.name: Steady Aim
techniques.effect: Standing still and not firing builds Aim pips; the next arrow spends them for extra power.

fx: aim pips over the bow hand

upgrade.name: Steady Aim II
upgrade.effect: Pips build faster, and a full three-pip arrow pierces one foe.

techniques.name: Hook and Loose
techniques.binding: primary within 0.4 s after the billhook sweep
techniques.effect: A point-blank arrow follows the sweep and knocks the nearest foe back.

new_clips: secondary_loose (8 drawings: the sweep's settle into a quick draw)

upgrade.name: Hook and Loose II
upgrade.effect: The sweep also staggers light foes, so the arrow lands.

techniques.name: Briar Snare
techniques.binding: lower the buckler within 0.5 s after it blocks a hit
techniques.effect: A briar snare drops at your feet and roots the next ground foe that steps on it.

upgrade.name: Briar Snare II
upgrade.effect: Two snares at once; a foe rooted by Briarshot springs the nearest snare too.
